title: Paro Taktsang (Tiger's Nest)
summary: Paro Taktsang, the Tiger's Lair, is a cliffside temple in the Paro Valley of western Bhutan. Legend says Padmasambhava flew there on a tiger's back. Scholar John Ardussi, in an essay for the Rubin Museum, dates the temple to 1692–1694, built by command of Desi Tenzin Rabgye, and records a 1998 fire that damaged its murals.
